ValidationRule.description: A validation rule will prevent advancement into Negotiation when Type is blank.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(Bypass_Validation__c), ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Solutioning"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Negotiation"), ISPICKVAL(Type, "") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Type must be populated before an Opportunity can be advanced to the Negotiation stage.
